Inglewood, California
  July 23, 2019

The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
Tuesday, July 23, 2019, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.
Mayor Butts called the City Council into session for Closed Session at the hour of
1:04 p.m.

The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor Butts, Council Members Dotson, Padilla,
  Morales, and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.

City officials and personnel present for Closed Session were as follows:

  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk
  Artie Fields  City Manager
  Ken Campos  City Attorney
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING CLOSED SESSION ITEMS. Mayor
Butts inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address the City
Council on the Closed Session Item.

There was no response.

Mayor Butts recessed the City Council at the hour of 1:05 p.m. for Closed Session
Item No. CS-1.

  *****************

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called
the City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing
Authority, and Finance Authority, at the hour of 2:01 p.m.
The City Clerk/ Successor Agency Secretary/ Housing Authority
Secretary/Finance Authority Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as
follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing
  Authority Chairman/Finance Authority Chairman
  Butts, Council Members/Successor Agency
  Members/Housing Authority Members/Finance
  Authority Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales and
  Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.
City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Finance Authority officials and
personnel present were as follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

* Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, and Finance
Authority.

  1
 July 23, 2019

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/Finance Authority Chairman Butts
  inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address the City
  Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Finance Authority on any item on
  the Agenda.

  Ray Davis, 2nd District, spoke concerning payment of the bills.

  Willie Agee thanked Ray Davis for his last comments.

 142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council
  Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Morales and
  seconded by Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority
  Member Dotson that the demands presented to the City Council/Successor
  Agency/Housing Authority dated, July 19, 2019, in the amount of $3,077,641.89,
  are hereby allowed, and the City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing
  Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to certify upon said registers that said
  demands are so approved. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority
  Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor/Successor
  Agency Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  142  PUBLIC HEARING HELD – DELINQUENT REFUSE AND SEWER
  ACCOUNTS FOR DIRECT PROPERTY TAX ASSESSMENT;
  RESOLUTION NO. 19-95 ADOPTED – MAKING FINDINGS AND
  OVERRULING PROTESTS AND OBJECTIONS, AND ORDERING THE
  DELINQUENT SEWER FEES AND REFUSE CHARGES BE PLACED ON
  THE TAX ROLLS FOR FISCAL YEAR 2019-2020; CITY CLERK
  DIRECTED TO FILE THE NECESSARY DOCUMENTS PLACING THE
  DELINQUENT REFUSE AND SEWER ACCOUNTS ON THE COUNTY
  OF LOS ANGELES PROPERTY TAX ROLLS. The City Clerk announced
  that the next scheduled matter was a public hearing to consider placing delinquent
  refuse and sewer accounts for direct property tax assessment, that notice had been
  given in the time form, and manner as required by law, and no communications
  were received.

  Artie Fields, City Manager, presented the Staff Report dated July 23, 2019.

  Sharon Koike, Assistant Finance Director, gave a brief oral report.

  Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present that wished to address the
  City Council on this matter.

  There was no response.

  Following discussion, it was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded
  by Council Member Dotson that the City Council does hereby 1) Adopt
  Resolution No. 19-95 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD,  CALIFORNIA  MAKING  FINDINGS  AND
  OVERRULING PROTESTS AND OBJECTIONS AND ORDERING
  DELINQUENT SEWER AND REFUSE CHARGES TO BE PLACED
  ON THE TAX ROLLS FOR FISCAL YEAR 2019-2020, PURSUANT
  TO THE HEALTH AND SAFETY CODE SECTION 5470, ET SEQ

  and 2) Direct the City Clerk to file the necessary documents placing the
  delinquent refuse and sewer accounts on the County of Los Angeles property tax
  rolls. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts;
  and

  2
 July 23, 2019

  Noes:  None.

  132  CLAIMS DENIED. Letters from the Office of the City Attorney recommending
  specific actions be taken on various claim filings:

  A. Reject the following claims in accordance with Government Code Section 913:
  1) Idalia Almendarez for alleged personal injury on December 13, 2018.
  2) Kelli A. Clift (1st Claim) for alleged personal injury on June 5, 2019.
  3) Kelli A. Clift (2nd Claim) for alleged personal injury on June 9, 2019.
  4) Michael Espinoza for alleged property damage on June 16, 2019.
  5) John Harrison for an alleged bill dispute on an Unknown Date.
  6) Teodoro Hernandez for alleged property damage on November 26, 2018.
  7) Rosalind Kelly for alleged property damage on May 13, 2019.
  8) Byron Recinos for alleged property damage on April 9, 2019.
  9) Danielle Aguirre for alleged property damage on January, 2019.*
  B. Deny application for leave to present a late claim pursuant to Government
  Code Section 911.6 for the following:
  1) Kenneth Mayfield for alleged personal injury on November 16, 2018.

  * Amended Claim

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member
  Dotson and carried that the above listed claims be denied.

  MINUTES. It was moved by Council Member Morales and seconded by Council
  Member Dotson that the Minutes for the City Council Meeting held on June 25,
  2019, be approved. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts;
  and
  Noes: None.

125  YOUTH REINVESTMENT GRANT FUNDING – APPROVED;
  RESOLUITON NO. 19-96 ADOPTED – AUTHORIZING THE
  SUBMISSION OF A CALGRIP GRANT APPLICATION. Staff report dated
  July 23, 2019, was presented recommending approval to accept the Youth
  Reinvestment Grant funding from the Board of State and Community Corrections
  for the City of Inglewood I-CARE Program.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member
  Dotson that the City Council does hereby: 1) Approve acceptance of the grant
  funding; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 19-96 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA ADOPTING A RESOLUTION
  AUTHORIZING THE SUBMISSION OF A CALGRIP GRANT
  APPLICATION AND GRANTING THE MAYOR THE
  AUTHORITY TO SIGN CONTRACT AMENDMENTS AND
  ALL RELATED AND SUBSEQUENT DOCUMENTS OF SAID
  GRANT WITHOUT THE NEED OF BRINGING SAID ITEMS
  TO THE CITY COUNCIL

  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts;
  and
  Noes:  None.

171  AGREEMENT NO. 19-245 APPROVED – COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES
  WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT, AGING AND COMMUNITY

  recommending approval of Agreement No. SSP192005 between the County of

  $75,186 for the provision of Care Management Services for Senior Citizens and

  motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts;
  and
  Noes: None.

 180  PAYMENT OF INVOICE NO. 11689 APPROVED – AMPSS
  INDUSTRIAL, INC. Staff report dated July 23, 2019, was presented

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member

 July 23, 2019
